line: Crowley's Four of Wands is the card for the third decan of Aries, with Venus as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aries.

quotes.quote: In the Wand suit, the card is called Completion.
It is also referred to Venus in Aries

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Chesed in the suit of Fire.
